gap_analysis: NVFP4, int 95f48ac5b4 (D-GEMM, EN, D-MOE, P-MOE sub-calls+S3, P-KDA, D-TOPK, D-FUSE). MegaMoE family achievable is now the perf-model fused layer (the step benches had summed dispatch/fc/combine + P11/P12 additively, double counting the link overlap; with the fused row the per-family sum equals the model step). Decode 1-node slice (die-split EP32 emulation, L24): r8/r16/r24 6190/8232/10011 us vs model ach 2403/2864/3338 (x2.58/2.87/3.00); r24 exposed vs ach (us): preview-drafter tail 4045 vs 279, BF16 GEMMs 1573 vs 732, MegaMoE 1608 vs 850, small elementwise 683 vs 39, KDA core 899 vs 473, DSA q/MLA/DCP 669 vs 249, top-k 313 vs 12, indexer 234 vs 106. Prefill real DEP16 (4 nodes, 93L, int c8a403aa7f): F16K 794.5 ms (20.6K tok/s/GPU) vs model 532.8 (x1.49); MegaMoE 263.8 vs fused 197.9 (x1.33, NVLink-bound at EP16, S3 does not move it), KDA core 79.7 vs 17.4, sparse MLA 49.2 vs 15.4, router/latent/top-k/norm 80.5 vs 48.0, indexer+top-k 61.6 vs 33.8. Prefill slice F16K/F8K 197.4/99.7 vs fused ach 140.6/71.9 (x1.40). Decode real D3-32 8-node on the new int pending (hold8 shared with a D-TOPK 4-GPU job).
inefficiencies: Slice deviation: 24-layer view (896 experts x 93 layers do not fit at EP4); model rows rescaled to the same layer counts
Slice deviation: MegaMoE dispatch/combine over 4 GPUs instead of 32 (decode) / 16 (prefill)
Slice deviation: only the DSpark PREVIEW drafter exists on Lustre (MLA, full-context attention); use target-only numbers or -x
Integration: D-GEMM and EN merged textually clean but broke at import (renamed mxfp8 predicate); fixed on int
plan: Merge landed-ready workstreams into int (int_tests4.sh + NVFP4 slice A/B per merge); D-FUSE (sp_coverage meta device) and P-MOE (re-base on post-D-MOE int) were sent back
Re-run d8/p16 NVFP4 on int at milestones (hold8 queue: one standing request)
Release DSpark drafter on Lustre would remove the preview-drafter tail artifact (needs the user/EN for the checkpoint)
